description: List all available knowledge bases (KBs) and their document counts.
name: kb_list

description: Search a specific knowledge base. Multimodal by default: fuses text-chunk and rendered-PDF-page retrieval (RRF) via the Qwen3-VL retrieval model. Returns top chunks with source_file, text, fused_score (RRF fusion value), reranker_prob (VL reranker probability, visual rows only), and kind (text|visual).
name: kb_search

description: Search across all knowledge bases simultaneously (multimodal, RRF-fused). Useful when the user's question could be answered by any KB.
name: kb_search_all

description: Admin: ingest files from a directory into a knowledge base. Text chunks are VL-embedded; PDF pages are additionally rendered to images and embedded in the same pass (multimodal index). Reads .md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/.pptx/.xlsx/.html/.epub.
name: kb_ingest

fts.description: Build a native Lance BM25 full-text index after ingest (enables query_type fts/hybrid on this KB)

source_dir.description: Absolute path to directory of source files

description: Admin: build an IVF_PQ vector index on a KB for faster search. Skipped automatically for KBs under 256 chunks (brute-force is already fast). Run after large ingests.
name: kb_optimize

description: List a KB's LanceDB version history and named tags (e.g. automatic pre-rebuild tags). Use with kb_restore to roll back.
name: kb_versions

description: Admin: restore a KB to an earlier LanceDB version (see kb_versions). The restore itself is a new version, so it can be undone.
name: kb_restore
